rows.reason: The old item and its proposed successor ask for the exact same atomic retrieval: Konjunktiv I (derived from the present stem) as the primary choice for distanced indirect speech.

The old synthesis prompt bundles Konjunktiv I endings, the three-step substitution cascade, Konjunktiv II formation/functions and an applied transformation exercise; no single Academy card holds that whole retrieval.
Identifying Zustandspassiv belongs to Grade 6 LehrplanPLUS D6 4.2.3 and is already kept active in deutsch-gymnasium-6; Grade 7 does not claim this Grade 6 voice item.

The old prompt combines active/passive voices, five passive tense forms and infinitive-group comma rules; only the comma part overlaps with Grade 7, and deutsch-gymnasium-6 already inventories this item as keep-active.
Both the legacy item and its proposed successor preserve the exact atomic retrieval of the four mandatory parts in the summary opening sentence (Titel, Autor, Textsorte, Thema).

The old prompt requires explaining the whole summary structure (TATT, chronological sections, tense rules, objectivity, indirect speech) and includes a detailed sample model; no single new card preserves all parts together.
Both items test the same core atomic knowledge: why the ballad unites all three literary genres (Epik, Lyrik and Dramatik).

The old synthesis prompt bundles ballad genre triad, three sub-types across Goethe/Schiller/Fontane and the three-step interpretation plan; the new Grade 7 item focuses on distinguishing the three aspects in Goethe's Erlkönig.
